words: Check each AI troubleshooting request compiles (the AI card's Test)

why.model: AI troubleshooting's own (modules/ai/pins/fixit_troubleshoot.json; the operator, 2026-11-15: the schema check runs on the model the feature uses, never only the cheap one, since the morning's failure came from an untested assumption). tests/test_ai_card_compile_check.py holds the two equal.
why.max_prompt_tokens: The largest schema sent, v10's 3,173 characters, plus the check's prompt (about 400 characters), at the gateway's 1.8 characters a token is about 2,000; 4,000 is about twice that, and a request over the bound is refused, never trimmed.
why.max_tokens: The check needs no answer: the provider compiles the schema before it writes, so a call cut at 64 tokens shows the schema compiled, and a schema it cannot compile is refused with HTTP 400 before any output.
